data.name: HostUnexpectedError
data.value: Something went wrong and this request could not be completed. Please try again. If it keeps happening, contact support and give them the correlation id shown with this message — it is what they need to find your request.

data.name: HostRateLimited
data.value: Too many requests were sent in a short time. Please wait until the time given in the Retry-After header has passed, then try again.
